definition: a long step in walking or running; a stride.
example_en: His stride was very long while running.

definition: a building or room-like object that moves; an airplane.
example_en: An airplane moved swiftly across the sky.

definition: the gland in animals that produces reproductive cells; the gonadal gland.
example_en: The doctor examined the health of the patient's gonadal gland.

definition: to be intermingled; to be blended; to mix with.
example: ಎರಡು ಬಣ್ಣಗಳು ಕಲೆಬೆರೆದು ಹೊಸ ಬಣ್ಣ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: Two colours got intermingled and became a new colour.

definition: a professional fighter; a warrior; a soldier.
example_en: There were many professional warriors in the king's court.

definition: (collectively) male human beings (as a class distinct from female beings).
example: ಆ ಕಾರ್ಖಾನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗಂಡುಜನ ಮಾತ್ರ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Only male workers work in that factory.

definition: (fem.) one who draws or paints pictures.
example: ಚಿತ್ರಿಕೆ ತನ್ನ ಕುಂಚದಿಂದ ಸುಂದರವಾದ ಚಿತ್ರವನ್ನು ಬಿಡಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: The female painter drew a beautiful picture with her brush.

definition: a man who is a terror to gods in the war.
example: ಅಮರದಲ್ಲಣನಾದ ಆ ವೀರನು ಯುದ್ಧದಲ್ಲಿ ದೇವತೆಗಳನ್ನೂ ಹೆದರಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That hero, a terror to the gods, frightened even the deities in battle.

definition: to speak bitterly, disrespectfully or contemptuously.
example_en: Seeing the one who lost, she laughed and spoke contemptuously.

definition: not bent; straight.
example_en: That stick was unbent and straight.

definition: the quality of not giving in or relenting; a being unyielding.
example_en: His unyielding nature did not bend to any pressure.

definition: a man who owes something to another or others; a loanee; a debtor.
example_en: That debtor was worried, unable to repay the loan.

definition: an idol of Gauri, the wife of Śiva, made of earth.
example_en: During the festival, they made an idol of Gauri from clay and worshipped it.

definition: moving; not firm or fixed.
example: ಇಂದಿನ ಕಾಲ ಬಹಳ ತರಸ, ಯಾವುದೂ ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Today's times are very unstable, nothing is fixed.

definition: an accomplishing; completion; accomplishment.
example_en: He achieved accomplishment through hard work.

definition: an inflamed, painful, pus-filled swelling around the genitals caused by a venereal disease.
example_en: The doctor gave medicine for the painful genital swelling.

definition: a ball of silk or cotton thread in the warp of a loom; a skein.
example_en: The weaver arranged the skein of thread in the loom.

definition: a devastating fire.
example: ಗ್ರಾಮದ ಬಳಿ ಪೊಡೆಗಿಚ್ಚು ಹಬ್ಬಿ ಆತಂಕ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: A devastating fire spread near the village and caused fear.

definition: a man who habitually engages himself in antisocial activities or creates commotion in the society.
example_en: That troublemaker created commotion in the town.

definition: a foreign king.
example: ಪರಮಂಡಲಿಕನು ನಮ್ಮ ರಾಜ್ಯದ ಮೇಲೆ ದಂಡೆತ್ತಿ ಬಂದನು.
example_en: The foreign king invaded our kingdom.

definition: the quality of being very light.
example_en: Because of the cotton's lightness, it floated in the air.

definition: to suppose what seems to one to be probably true; to form or express an opinion; to opine.
example: ಈ ವಿಷಯದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ಅಭಿಪ್ರಾಯವನ್ನು ಅಂಘೈಸಿದನು.
example_en: He formed and expressed his opinion on this matter.

definition: the act or an instance of opening the mouth wide involuntarily, and breathing deeply; yawn.
example_en: A yawn came to her in the middle of the lecture.

definition: to fasten oneself to another as by gluing; to stick oneself to; to be glued to.
example: ಅಂಟು ಬಳಸಿ ಎರಡು ಕಾಗದಗಳನ್ನು ಪಗಿಲ್ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: Using glue, he stuck the two papers together.

definition: the quality or condition of being weak, loose, broken; weakness.
example_en: Because of the rain, the weakness of the wall is clearly visible.

definition: the number of times any action or occurrence is repeated.
example: ಆ ಘಟನೆ ಎಷ್ಟು ಕಿತ್ತ ನಡೆಯಿತು ಎಂದು ಅವನಿಗೆ ನೆನಪಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: He does not remember how many times that incident occurred.

definition: an activity engaged in for amusement or recreation; a sport; a play.
example_en: The children were engaged in play in the field.

definition: a man feeling little or no emotion; an apathetic man.
example_en: Being an apathetic man, he showed no emotion towards anything.

definition: curdled milk; curds.
example_en: In summer, curds turn sour quickly.

definition: continuously; incessantly.
example_en: The rain kept pouring incessantly.

definition: a deep liking for music; taste for music.
example_en: He had a deep liking for music since his childhood.

definition: the household work of sweeping and bringing water.
example: ಆ ಹುಡುಗಿ ಮನೆಯ ಕಸನೀರು ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: That girl was doing the household work of sweeping and bringing water.

definition: crazy behaviour.
example_en: His crazy behaviour increased after he drank.

definition: the female, large, black-and-white diving bird of prey, Pandion haliaetus of Pandionidae family which feeds mainly on fish; an osprey.
example: ಕುರರಿ ನೀರಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಹಾರಿ ಮೀನನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿಯಿತು.
example_en: The osprey flew over the water and caught a fish.

definition: (anat.) the vermiform appendix.
example_en: The doctor performed surgery on the vermiform appendix.

definition: a state of extreme necessity, danger, etc; extremity.
example_en: That family was caught in extreme distress.

definition: the frenzied action of a ghost.
example_en: That night the ghost's frenzied act took place in the cemetery.

definition: to wander, roam with (some one).
example_en: The two friends were wandering together in the town.

definition: a pair of small scissors used to make button-holes; a button-hole scissor.
example_en: The tailor used the button-hole scissors to cut the button-hole.

definition: a woman who obtains men and women for the purpose of prostitution; a procuress.
example_en: That procuress used to procure and sell women.

definition: liability to injury, damage, loss or pain; peril; danger.
example_en: Fire can cause danger, so be careful.

definition: the first meal of the day usu. a light one; breakfast.
example: ಶಾಲೆಗೆ ಹೋಗುವ ಮುನ್ನ ಮಗು ನ್ಯಾರೆ ಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: The child had breakfast before going to school.

definition: eager and hurried activities esp. by large number of persons thronging at a place; busy haste.
example_en: There was busy haste of people thronging in front of the shop.

definition: to hold or seize with the hand.
example_en: The soldier seized the sword with his hand.

definition: a loud shout; an outcry.
example_en: The children's loud shouting filled the whole house.

definition: to give, send or do (something) what has been given or sent.
example_en: He returned the gift he had received.

definition: an objection; an instance of remonstrating; a protest.
example: ಜನರು ಆ ನಿರ್ಧಾರದ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಓರಂಡಲ ಎತ್ತಿದರು.
example_en: The people raised a protest against that decision.

definition: a low, subdued voice.
example_en: She whispered the secret in a low, subdued voice.

definition: an enforced living away from or beyond the boundaries of one's town, province, country.
example: ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯ ಆ ಅಪರಾಧಿಗೆ ಹದ್ದುಪಾರು ಶಿಕ್ಷೆ ವಿಧಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The court imposed a sentence of banishment on that criminal.

definition: a woman who sees or watches something (without taking an active part); a spectator; an onlooker.
example_en: The spectator watched the match from the gallery.

definition: a young child.
example_en: That young child was playing in the yard.

definition: (a business) to run into loss.
example: ಆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನು ಕೈಕಚ್ಚಿ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಹಣ ಕಳೆದುಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: He ran into heavy loss in that business and lost all his money.

definition: a small quantity of buttermilk used as a flux to convert milk into curds.
example_en: She added a little buttermilk to the milk and made curds.

definition: the act of cooperating secretly (with someone), esp. in wrongdoing; connivance.
example: ಕಳ್ಳತನದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನ ಶರೀಕು ಇತ್ತೆಂದು ಪೋಲೀಸರು ಶಂಕಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The police suspected that he had secretly connived in the theft.

definition: a small container for ink.
example_en: They had kept the ink container on the table.

definition: the act of bending or dangling from one side anoher repeatedly.
example_en: The swinging motion of the swing delighted the children.

definition: the act or an instance of traveling from one place to another; a journey.
example_en: They set out on a pilgrimage to Kashi.

definition: to be heedful; to bother for the good of another.
example_en: He bothers himself for the good of his younger sister.

definition: a tail (of an animal) that is wagging.
example_en: It was delightful to see the dog's wagging tail.

definition: a cleaning of cotton fibres.
example_en: In the mill, the cleaning of cotton fibres is done by machines.

definition: (myth.) a daemon, as an enemy of the gods.
example_en: The gods gathered together to defeat the demon who was the enemy of the gods.

definition: a variety of honey (that has good medicinal values).
example_en: Physicians use this medicinal honey as medicine.

definition: the gaseous envelope (air) surrounding the earth; the atmosphere.
example_en: The atmosphere envelops the earth.

definition: a working very hard.
example_en: The farmer's hard work bore fruit.

definition: immeiately; suddenly.
example_en: Suddenly it began to rain.

definition: the opposite corner.
example_en: There is an old tree in the opposite corner of the house.

definition: any wild animal.
example_en: All kinds of wild animals roamed freely in the forest.

definition: (mus.) a loud, clear sound (?).
example_en: A loud, clear sound came from that instrument.

definition: (myth.) any of the eight celestial elephants holding the world on their back.
example: ಪುರಾಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಶಾಗಜಗಳು ಲೋಕವನ್ನು ಹೊತ್ತಿವೆ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: In mythology it is said that the celestial elephants hold up the world.

definition: a handkerchief or scarf worn around the neck.
example_en: He wore a scarf around his neck in winter.

definition: a person whose tendency, liking is to run.
example_en: He is one who likes to run, always running about.

definition: melodramatic pitiableness or humbleness.
example_en: That actor's melodramatic humbleness made the audience laugh.

definition: to swing back and forth; to shake or tremble frequently and continuously.
example_en: The tree branch was swaying back and forth in the wind.

definition: one who names or gives name to.
example_en: The namer of that text was a famous scholar.

definition: a drama that uses a number of musical compositions to depict the theme.
example: ಆಡುಗಬ್ಬದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಲವು ಹಾಡುಗಳು ಕಥೆಯನ್ನು ಮುಂದಕ್ಕೆ ಒಯ್ಯುತ್ತವೆ.
example_en: In the musical drama, several songs carry the story forward.

definition: to grip (the skin of part of the body of another person) tightly, esp. between the index finger and thumb, and squeeze; to pinch.
example_en: The child, crying, pinched its friend's hand.

definition: a loose, unsewn garment used by men to cover their upper part of the body.
example_en: He wrapped the loose upper garment over his shoulder.

definition: a small earthenware containing explosives which, when catches fire, explodes or gives colourful flower like sparks; a kind of fireworks.
example_en: On Diwali, the children rejoiced setting off the earthen firework.

definition: (collectively) dried leaves of a plants; trash; rubbish; refuse.
example_en: They swept the yard and put the dried leaves into the pit.

definition: that is not covered; open; unveiled.
example_en: The face appeared uncovered.

definition: a stone used as a base on which a building is constructed (often referred to the masonry, concrete works at the basement); a foundation stone.
example_en: The temple's foundation stone was very sturdy.

definition: an order; a command.
example_en: The sultan's order reached everyone.

definition: love; affectionate regard.
example: ಅವಳ ಅಚ್ಚಿಕೆ ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಸದಾ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: Her affectionate love was always upon her children.

definition: to speak slightingly of; to show disrespect for; to lower in esteem; to discredit; to belittle.
example: ಅವನು ಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನನ್ನ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ಇಳಿಸಿ ಮಾತನಾಡಿದ.
example_en: He spoke belittling my work in the meeting.

definition: to start one's journey.
example_en: We started our journey and began the trip.

definition: shining; lustrous; brilliant.
example_en: Brilliant, shining stars twinkled in the sky.

definition: a man who makes or sells articles of gold; a goldsmith.
example_en: That goldsmith was famous in the village itself.

definition: (dial.) to pause hesitatingly while talking.
example_en: When asked the question, he stood there pausing hesitatingly.

definition: to free from fetters; to free from restraint or imprisonment; to unfetter.
example_en: The soldier freed the prisoner from his fetters.

definition: a huge sea wave caused by a great disturbance under an ocean, as a strong earthquake or volcanic eruption; a tsunami.
example_en: A terrible tsunami arose in the sea due to the earthquake.

definition: the act or process of washing rice in water before being cooked.
example: ಅಡುಗೆ ಮಾಡುವ ಮೊದಲು ಅಕ್ಕಿಯ ಅರಕ ಮಾಡಬೇಕು.
example_en: Before cooking, the rice must be washed.

definition: a kind of bird.
example: ಕೊಳದ ಬಳಿ ರುಕ್ಮಕ ಹಕ್ಕಿ ನೀರು ಕುಡಿಯುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A rukmaka bird was drinking water near the pond.

definition: the quality of cheating; fraud.
example_en: Everyone was cheated because of his fraud.

definition: delicate artistic work.
example_en: The delicate artistic work stood out in that sculpture.

definition: a means, apparatus, instrument, etc. used in addition to the main one; an accessory.
example_en: The work was not complete without that accessory apparatus.

definition: undaunted courage.
example_en: His undaunted courage astonished everyone.

definition: to pass the days.
example_en: Grandmother passes her days playing with her grandchildren.

definition: the female parent; the mother.
example_en: The mother played with the child affectionately.

definition: the supporting structure, usu. most part of which remains underground, on which a building is or can be constructed; foundation.
example_en: The foundation of the building has been laid firmly.

definition: (fig.) to earn one's livelihood (in a meager way).
example_en: That poor labourer was earning his livelihood with difficulty.

definition: an ornament for the wrist.
example_en: A golden wrist-ornament adorned her hand.

definition: a husband.
example_en: Her husband was a merchant.

definition: (hist.) a horse bred in the Sindhu region.
example_en: There were horses bred in the Sindhu region in the king's stable.

definition: most favourable or desirable; best; optimum; optimal.
example_en: This is the most optimal solution to this problem.

definition: preceding in time; earlier; past; former.
example_en: He was the former village head of this town.

definition: a wise and intelligent counsellor.
example_en: The king had a wise and intelligent counsellor.

definition: a wrong or wicked act; crime, sin, etc.; a misdeed.
example_en: He repented for the misdeed he had committed.

definition: having or expressing an oponion, viewpoint, conception, idea etc.
example_en: He spoke opinionated words on this matter.

definition: to enter into; to come into.
example_en: He entered into the palace.

definition: a person who works in or is skilled in the techniques of, any of the fine arts, esp. in painting, drawing, sculpture,drama, etc.; an artist.
example_en: That artist drew a beautiful painting.

definition: an alternative name, title or appellation.
example_en: People speak the poet's alternative name with respect.

definition: news which is in circulation, that is not confirmed or is baseless.
example_en: An unconfirmed rumor spread in the town and people got frightened.

definition: a species of fish.
example_en: Nakula fish were swimming in the pond.

definition: the plant Trigonrlla corniculata of Papilionaceae family.
example_en: The plant lankopige grows in the green grass.

definition: full of high spirits and good humour; merry; gay; jolly.
example_en: During the festival, everyone danced about, full of merry high spirits.

definition: the army of one's enemy; the army one is fighting against.
example_en: Our army defeated the enemy's army.

definition: having the form of a circle; circular; round.
example_en: That stone was circular in shape.

definition: the act of seeing or being seen.
example_en: People had been waiting since morning for a sight of the guru.

definition: the grass Chloris polystachia of Poaceae family.
example_en: The cattle were grazing on the kadlegangara grass.

definition: (a reverberating sound) to sound continuously in the ears or perceived to be so, usu. after a heavy sound is heard.
example_en: After the thunderclap, a ringing kept sounding in my ears.

definition: a collection of materials, accumulated for some purpose (as building materials for construction of a house).
example_en: We collected the materials needed to build the house.

definition: the front part of the human body from the waist to the knees when in a sitting position; the lap.
example_en: The child lay in the mother's lap and slept.

definition: an adding of two or more quantities to get the total of those quantities; addition.
example_en: The addition of these numbers comes to a hundred.

definition: a pot made of soap-stone.
example_en: Grandmother kept the curd in the soap-stone pot.

definition: a pole on which a flag is raised and flown; a flag-pole.
example_en: They installed a new flag-pole in front of the shrine.

definition: to receive alms.
example: ಆ ಬಡ ಸಾಧು ಮನೆ ಮನೆ ತಿರುಗಿ ಬೈಕಂಗೊಂಡ.
example_en: That poor mendicant went door to door and received alms.

definition: without talking; quietly; silently.
example_en: She was sitting quietly without talking.

definition: an exemption from paying tax or the sum exempted from being paid.
example_en: The farmers received an exemption from the tax.

definition: the act or process of arranging organising something in an orderly manner.
example_en: The committee had made good arrangements for the meeting.

definition: the state of being an idiot; foolishness; idiocy; stupidity.
example_en: Everyone laughed at his stupidity.

definition: a loud cry or continuous loud cries.
example_en: A loud cry was heard from the direction of the ground.

definition: a bald head.
example_en: Seeing his bald head, the children laughed.

definition: a long, stabbing weapon for thrusting or throwing, consisting of a shaft with a sharp-pointed head; a spear.
example_en: The soldier stood holding a spear in his hand.

definition: sadness; grief; sorrow; distress.
example: ತಾಯಿಯ ಅಗಲಿಕೆಯ ಉಮ್ಮಳಿ ಅವನನ್ನು ಬಹಳ ದಿನ ಕಾಡಿತು.
example_en: The sorrow of his mother's separation troubled him for many days.

definition: the state of being upside down or reversed condition.
example_en: The boat turned upside down and floated in the water.

definition: the plant Croton tigilium of Euphorbiaceae family.
example_en: The Croton tiglium tree is used for medicine.

definition: to move from place to place.
example: ಆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿ ಊರೂರು ಕೊಲ್ಲಣಿಸುತ್ತಾ ಸರಕು ಮಾರುತ್ತಿದ್ದ.
example_en: That merchant sold goods while moving from place to place.

definition: to shower sparks on.
example_en: The blacksmith showers sparks while hammering the iron.

definition: to become dry; to lose water by evaporation or percolation; to become dry or sapless.
example: ಬಿಸಿಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಣಗಲು ಹಾಕಿದ ಬಟ್ಟೆ ಬೇಗ ಕಟ್ಟೆಹಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The cloth put out in the sun to dry soon became dry.

definition: to keep oneself from being seen; to hide (oneself).
example_en: The child hid itself in the room.

definition: a thick mixture of clay, and sometimes sand, with water; puddle.
example_en: During the rainy season, the path was full of clay puddle.

definition: any of the games of chance played for money or some other stakes; gambling.
example: ಜುಗಾರಿ ಆಡಿ ಅವನು ಎಲ್ಲ ಹಣ ಕಳೆದುಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: He lost all his money by gambling.

definition: thin; slender; physically weak.
example_en: Due to illness, his body looks thin and weak.

definition: a man practising a profession; a tradesman; a professional.
example_en: He is a skilled tradesman.

definition: to cause to pulverise or get pulverised.
example_en: The workers had the rock pulverised.

definition: to be a resident (of a place); to be settled in a place.
example_en: His family was settled as residents in this village.

definition: to divide (something) and distribute between or among.
example_en: They divided the profit and distributed it to all the members.

definition: the plant Cannabis sativa of Cannabinaceae family; grown for the tough fibre in its stem; ganja; hemp plant.
example: ರೈತರು ಕುಸುವನ್ನು ಬೆಳೆದು ಅದರ ನಾರಿನಿಂದ ಹಗ್ಗ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Farmers grow the hemp plant and make rope from its fibre.

definition: to inject a serum, vaccine, etc. into (a living organism), esp. in order to create immunity against small pox; to inoculate.
example_en: They inoculated the village children against small pox.

definition: small; tiny.
example_en: She fastened the cloth with small buttons.

definition: that which is brand-new.
example_en: Only brand-new items are available in the shop.

definition: not desirable; undesirable; objectionable.
example_en: That rude behaviour was undesirable.

definition: a man who makes garlands; a man who sells flowers, flower garlands, bouquets, etc.; a flower seller; a florist.
example: ಹುವ್ವಾಡಿಗ ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹೂವಿನ ಹಾರ ಮಾರುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: The florist used to sell flower garlands in the market every day.

definition: a territory, usu. of considerable size, in which a single rulership holds sway.
example_en: That ruler's kingdom had spread far and wide.

definition: a children's game in which one player tries to find the other players, who have hidden; hide-and-seek.
example_en: The children are playing hide-and-seek in the garden.

definition: a kind of pudding prepared with black gram or rice and cooked in steam.
example_en: The grandmother made the steamed pudding and served it to her grandchildren.

definition: a gleam or streak of a rainbow in the clouds.
example_en: A streak of rainbow gleamed among the clouds.

definition: one who keeps company with another; a companion.
example: ಅವನ ತತ್ತುಕನಾಗಿ ನಾನು ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಅವನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಓದುತ್ತೇನೆ.
example_en: As his companion, I study with him every day.

definition: a passing of semen along with urine.
example_en: Because of the problem of passing semen with urine, he consulted a doctor.

definition: foot wear, as slippers made of leather.
example_en: She wore leather slippers and set out for the temple.

definition: that is hot.
example: ಬಿಸಿಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಇಟ್ಟಿದ್ದ ತಪುತ ಕಬ್ಬಿಣ ಕೈಗೆ ಸುಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: The hot iron left in the sun burned his hand.

definition: (used in pl.) people who are inhabited in a forest; forest-dwellers.
example_en: The forest-dwellers lead a simple life in the hills.

definition: the entrance of a town.
example_en: Guards were standing near the entrance of the town.

definition: the art of stealing.
example: ಆ ಗ್ರಂಥ ಹಳೆಯ ತಸ್ಕರಶಾಸ್ತ್ರದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: That book describes the ancient art of stealing.

definition: a play with pebbles.
example_en: In the evening the girls were playing the pebble game.

definition: something offered as bet (as in a wager, game, contest, etc.); to stake.
example: ಆಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ಬೆಳ್ಳಿಯ ಉಂಗುರವನ್ನು ತೆಱವಿಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: In the game he stakes his silver ring.

definition: a pulling up by the roots; a removing without leaving a trace; eradication.
example_en: That bad custom must be eradicated.

definition: any food prepared by frying in oil.
example_en: Mother prepared oil-fried food for the festival.

definition: to claim a share in or part of (something).
example_en: He wished to claim a share in the property.

definition: the tree Carallia brachiata ( = C. integrifolia, = C. lucida) of Rhizophoraceae family; inland mangrove.
example_en: The shade of the inland mangrove tree was cool.

definition: an expert in cheating.
example_en: He is an expert cheater who easily deceives people.

definition: the quality of the minḍs stability, calmness, judgement, etc. not being affected by external influences.
example_en: Even in distress, his calm composure did not waver.

definition: towards outside.
example_en: The dog ran towards outside of the house.

definition: courage; braveness.
example_en: That warrior's courage never diminished.

definition: a scoring point in cricket, made by a successful running of both batsmen from one wicket to the other; a run.
example_en: The batsman ran and scored one run.

definition: an envious person.
example: ಅವನು ಕಿಸುರೊಡಲನಾಗಿದ್ದು ನನ್ನ ಯಶಸ್ಸನ್ನು ಕಂಡು ಹೊಟ್ಟೆಕಿಚ್ಚು ಪಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: He is an envious person and burns with jealousy at my success.

definition: preceding a particular event, time, etc.
example: ಸ್ವಾತಂತ್ರ್ಯ ಪೂರ್ವದ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಯನ್ನು ತತ್ಪೂರ್ವ ಕಾಲ ಎಂದು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The period preceding independence is called the tatpūrva era.

definition: a greedy man.
example: ಆ ಆಶೆಬುರುಕ ಇನ್ನೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಹಣ ಬಯಸಿದನು.
example_en: That greedy man desired even more money.

definition: a splitting or being split.
example_en: The splitting of the log happened easily.

definition: the quality or fact of being disinterested in sensual pleasures, worldly possessions, etc.
example_en: His disinterestedness in worldly pleasures surprised everyone.

definition: a Dravidian aboriginal clan living in and around Nilagiri region of Tamil Nadu in South India.
example: ತೋಡ ಜನಾಂಗದವರು ತಮ್ಮದೇ ಆದ ಪದ್ಧತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಪಾಲಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: The Toda clan follow their own customs.

definition: to be damaged or injured in such a way as to become useless, valueless, etc.; to decay (as food); to spoil (oneself).
example_en: The crop got spoiled due to the rain.

definition: to be joined; to be fastened.
example_en: The two pieces joined together firmly.

definition: the treatment of the body, as rubbing, kneading etc. of part of the body. massaging, nourishing with substances necessary to life and growth, etc.
example_en: The ayurvedic doctor gave the patient a body treatment.

definition: to cut away or strip of the skin, covering, surface, esp. of nuts, fruits, etc.
example_en: She peeled the fruit with a knife.

definition: a developing; development; progress; improvement; advancement.
example_en: The development of this project is progressing rapidly.

definition: an underground pipe or drain used to carry off water and waste matter; sewers.
example: ನಗರದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಳಚರಂಡಿ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: The sewer system in the city is not working properly.

definition: a man worthy of high praise; a glorious or illustrious man.
example_en: The teacher was truly a man worthy of high praise.

definition: a place, part of the town, where harlots live.
example: ಆ ಬೀದಿಯನ್ನು ಜನ ಸೂಳೆಗೇರಿ ಎಂದು ಗುರುತಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: People identify that street as the harlots' quarter.

definition: a man of high birth.
example: ಅವನೊಬ್ಬ ಕುಳೀನ, ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಅವನನ್ನು ಗೌರವದಿಂದ ಕಾಣುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: He is a man of high birth; everyone regards him with respect.

definition: the time yet to come; future time; the future.
example: ನಮ್ಮ ಭವಿಷ್ಯತ್ತು ಇಂದಿನ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅವಲಂಬಿಸಿದೆ.
example_en: Our future depends on today's effort.

definition: the back part of the (huyman) foot.
example_en: While running, the back of his foot hurt.

definition: a mixture of liquid hydrocarbons obtained by distilling petroleum, bituminous shale or the like, and widely used as a fuel, cleaning solvent, etc.; kerosene.
example_en: She poured kerosene into the lamp and lit it.

definition: to see; to look intently; to observe.
example_en: He looked intently at the scene from a distance.

definition: the humming sound of a bee.
example_en: The humming of bees was heard around the tree.

definition: Śiva, who lives in a mountain.
example_en: The devotees prayed to Shiva, who lives in the mountain.

definition: the tree Aleurites moluccana of Euphorbraceae family; candlenut tree;
example: ಅಕ್ರೋಟ ಮರದ ಬೀಜದ ಎಣ್ಣೆಯನ್ನು ದೀಪಕ್ಕೆ ಬಳಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: They used to use the candlenut tree's seed oil for lamps.

definition: a most unchaste, lustful or unloyal woman.
example: ಊರ ಜನ ಆ ಕಡುಪಾಱು ಹೆಂಗಸನ್ನು ದೂರವಿಟ್ಟರು.
example_en: The villagers kept that most unchaste woman at a distance.

definition: the act of spreading or daubing (an oily, greasy, viscous substance, paint, etc.) on or over something.
example_en: The daubing of lime on the wall was done well.

definition: a man who habitually lies; a lier.
example_en: No one believed that habitual liar's words.

definition: a kind of flat, buoyant structure of logs, boards, barrels, etc. fastened together.
example: ಮೀನುಗಾರರು ಸಾಗಡದ ಮೇಲೆ ನಿಂತು ಬಲೆ ಬೀಸಿದರು.
example_en: The fishermen stood on the raft and cast their net.

definition: to train or develop the knowledge, skill, mind or character of, esp. by formal schooling or study; to teach; to instruct; to educate.
example_en: The teacher educated the children with love.

definition: the part of the face below the lower lip; projecting part of the lower jaw; the chin.
example: ಅವನ ಗದ್ದದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಿಳಿ ಗಡ್ಡ ಬೆಳೆದಿದೆ.
example_en: A white beard has grown on his chin.

definition: the distance from the top downward, from the surface inward or from front to back; depth.
example: ಈ ಕೆರೆಯ ಆಳ ಎಷ್ಟಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಗೊತ್ತಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: I do not know how much depth this pond has.

definition: a kind of food prepared using various vegetables.
example_en: Mother made a vegetable dish for the festival.

definition: an injury to the tissues of a part of the body in which the skin is not broken; a bruise; contusion.
example_en: When he fell, his knee got a bruise.

definition: the larger roller in a sugar-mill.
example_en: In the sugar mill, the larger roller crushes the sugarcane.

definition: a chorus used by a group of women while carrying on works like grinding, pounding, winnowing, etc. in group.
example_en: The women sang the suvvi chorus while grinding.

definition: a hood made of leaves and twigs, for the head and back against rain.
example_en: The shepherd wore a leaf-and-twig hood for protection from the rain.

definition: to be subjected to purification as by being melted, distilled, etc.
example_en: The gold was purified by melting in the furnace.

definition: a collection of things, people, animals, etc.; a heap; an assemblage; a gathering.
example_en: A gathering of people had assembled at the fair.

definition: a hiss sound made expressing tiredness, grief, etc.
example: ಅವನ ಬಾಯಿಂದ ಒಂದು ಲಿಸ್ ಶಬ್ದ ಹೊರಬಂತು.
example_en: A hiss sound of tiredness came out of his mouth.

definition: (standing, sitting, doing, etc.) in front of.
example_en: He stood in front of the teacher and bowed.

definition: the eye that is large and round.
example: ಆ ಹುಡುಗಿಯ ಒಚ್ಚೇರೆಗಣ್ ನೋಡಲು ಬಹಳ ಸುಂದರವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That girl's large round eye was very beautiful to look at.

definition: a kind of tree.
example_en: A machada tree had grown at the foot of the hill.

definition: the act of killing, destroying insects.
example_en: The farmers destroyed the insects in the field.

definition: a customary way of doing something; a custom or practice.
example_en: Waking up early in the morning was his customary practice.

definition: food that is unfit for (human) consumption.
example_en: Even a hungry man does not want food unfit for consumption.

definition: any god whose food is ambrosia.
example_en: The god whose food is ambrosia heard his devotee's prayer.

definition: the act of going out of sight; a disappearing; disappearance.
example: ಮಂಜಿನ ನಶನದ ನಂತರ ಬೆಟ್ಟ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಕಂಡಿತು.
example_en: After the fog's disappearance, the hill was clearly seen.

definition: that which is built, constructed, woven or made.
example: ಈ ಹಳೆಯ ಕಟ್ಟಲು ನೂರು ವರ್ಷಗಳಷ್ಟು ಹಳೆಯದು.
example_en: This old structure is about a hundred years old.

definition: a hunting for sport.
example_en: He set out to the forest for a hunting expedition.

definition: to keep (something) or turn upside down; to invert.
example_en: He turned the empty vessel upside down.

definition: the act of moving slowly by dragging the body along the ground (as a worm); crawling.
example: ಹುಳುವಿನ ರಿಂಖವು ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ನೆಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಸಾಗಿತು.
example_en: The worm's crawling moved slowly along the ground.

definition: the state of being alive; life.
example_en: As long as life remains, desire remains.

definition: from the beginning to the end; entire; throughout.
example_en: He read this book from beginning to end.

definition: the quality or the fact of being a heroine.
example: ಆ ನಾಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾಯಿಕೆಯ ನಾಯಿಕೆತನವನ್ನು ಅವಳು ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ನಿರೂಪಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: In that play, she portrayed the quality of being a heroine very well.

definition: the meaning or intention of a sentence (independent of the meaning of the individual words used therein).
example_en: The teacher explained the meaning of that sentence.

definition: any small finchlike bird of the family Ploceidae, with brown and grey plumage Passer domesticus; a house sparrow.
example_en: The house sparrow was eating grain in the courtyard.

definition: a conference of people belonging to the same profession.
example_en: A conference of engineers convened today.

definition: the top part of the body in humans; the head.
example_en: When he fell, he got hurt on the head.

definition: the sap of cocoanut palm that is used in preparing alcoholic liquor.
example_en: He prepared toddy from the coconut palm sap.

definition: a bitter brownish addictive narcotic drug that consists of the dried juice of the opium poppy; opium.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲೆಮದ್ದನ್ನು ನೋವು ನಿವಾರಣೆಗೆ ಬಳಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: In olden times, opium was used to relieve pain.

definition: a tax (now obsolete) levied on persons, vehicles or goods on entering into a city, town or an administrative jurisdiction.
example: ಪಟ್ಟಣ ಪ್ರವೇಶಿಸುವ ಸರಕುಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಅನುಪು ವಿಧಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A tax was levied on goods entering the town.

definition: complete; comprehensive.
example: ಅವನ ಯೋಜನೆ ಅತಿಸಾಂಗವಾಗಿ ಎಲ್ಲ ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿತ್ತು.
example_en: His plan was comprehensive, covering all matters.

definition: an excellently brave man.
example_en: That excellently brave man faced the enemy army alone.

definition: to cause to go or leave a place.
example_en: The teacher made the student leave the classroom.

definition: a city or town that is the official seat of government of a state, nation, etc.; a capital.
example_en: Bengaluru is the capital of Karnataka.

definition: rising up or to a higher level; moving upward.
example_en: The smoke was rising upward toward the sky.

definition: the quality by which one excels another; excellence; surpassing goodness or merit; superiority.
example_en: His superiority was greater than everyone else's.

definition: belonging to a (certain) family.
example_en: He belongs to a wealthy family.

definition: an inordinate sense of self-importance; self-conceit; egotism.
example_en: His arrogant self-conceit annoyed everyone.

definition: a group of people associated together in some way; a gang.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ದೊಡ್ಡ ಪೋಳಿ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a big gang in that village.

definition: an abnormally low concentration of sugar in the blood; hypoglycaemia.
example_en: Symptoms of hypoglycaemia appeared in the patient.

definition: to be inlaid with pieces of wood, metal on to one's surface.
example_en: That cot was inlaid with pieces of gold.

definition: water moved backward or held back by a dam, tide, etc.; backwater.
example_en: Many villages were submerged in the dam's backwater.

definition: the act or an instance of cheating, deceiving; a condition that causes deception.
example_en: Everyone came to know about his deception.

definition: a burdensome, onerous task.
example: ಈ ಕಡುಗಜ್ಜವನ್ನು ಮುಗಿಸಲು ಬಹಳ ಸಮಯ ಬೇಕು.
example_en: It takes a long time to finish this burdensome task.

definition: the quality of being shameless; shamelessness; impudence.
example_en: Everyone was astonished seeing his shamelessness.

definition: a beautiful woman with slender belly and waist.
example_en: That slender-waisted beautiful woman captivated everyone with her dance.

definition: to get protected; to be protected, saved.
example_en: The child stranded in the forest got protected by the police.

definition: three quarters of a whole; ¾.
example: ಆ ಜಮೀನಿನ ಪೌಣೆ ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಮಾರಾಟ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: They sold three quarters of that land.

definition: a heavy, thick stick used as a weapon; a club.
example_en: He stood holding a club in his hand.

definition: special - a) of a kind different from others; distinctive, peculiar, distinguished; or unique; b) exceptional; extraordinary.
example: ಆ ಶಿಲ್ಪ ತನ್ನ ಅಸಾಧಾರಣ ಸೌಂದರ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧವಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: That sculpture is famous for its exceptional, distinctive beauty.

definition: any small, rounded, usu. inflamed swelling of the skin; a papule or pustule; a pimple.
example_en: A pimple is rising on his back.

definition: anything indistinct or hazy to the sight; blur.
example: ಮಂಜಿನ ಕಾರಣ ದೂರದ ಮನೆಗಳು ನೇಸಲಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿದ್ದವು.
example_en: Because of the fog, the distant houses appeared blurry.

definition: the purified butter, served with the food offered to a deity or to a person.
example_en: At the end of the worship they offered the purified butter to the deity.

definition: active physical or mental force or strength; vitality; vigour.
example_en: There was immense vigour in his words.

definition: to cause to walk.
example_en: The mother held the child's hand and made him walk.

definition: in the respiratory tract of most land vertebrates, the tube extending from the larynx to the two bronchi; the windpipe; the trachea.
example_en: The trachea carries air from the throat to the lungs.

definition: a foot not wearing footwear; a bare-foot.
example_en: She entered the temple bare-foot.

definition: a small fixed wheel, sometimes turning in a block, with a grooved rim in which a rope or chain runs, as to raise a weight attached at one end by pulling on the other end; a pulley.
example_en: They fitted a new pulley to the well.

definition: to come to an end; to terminate; to end.
example_en: The meeting came to an end at one o'clock.

definition: shining brightly; brilliant; splendid.
example_en: The moon shone brilliantly in the sky.

definition: to form a pair; to match; to pair.
example_en: These colors must be correctly paired.

definition: the office, status of a supreme leader.
example_en: He got the position of supreme leader of the group.

definition: to press hard or closely; exert pressure on as to extract juice, oil, etc.; to grind well.
example_en: They ground the sesame well and extracted the oil.

definition: the condition of somewhat dark; lack of sufficient light; dimness.
example_en: In the evening dimness the path was not clearly visible.

definition: an acute, severe, infectious disease, caused by bacteria Vibrio cholerae, characterised by profuse diarrhoea, vomiting, dehydration, cramps, etc.; cholera.
example_en: The villagers were shaken by the cholera epidemic.

definition: in a violent, cruel manner; violently; cruelly.
example_en: The robbers beat the people violently and cruelly.

definition: a doll, puppet made to resemble a human being.
example_en: Grandmother stitched a doll from cloth and gave it.

definition: audible expression of grief; lamentation; wail.
example_en: From the house of the dead, a loud lamentation was heard.

definition: a man belonging to and residing in the nation of his birth; a native.
example: ಆ ನಾಡಿಗ ವಿದೇಶದಲ್ಲೂ ತನ್ನ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಯನ್ನು ಉಳಿಸಿಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That native preserved his culture even in a foreign land.

definition: any collection of articles, as a vehicle, banner ornaments, armour, etc. used in a drama.
example: ನಾಟಕದ ವೇಷ್ಟಿಮವನ್ನು ಒಂದು ಪೆಟ್ಟಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜೋಪಾನವಾಗಿ ಇಟ್ಟಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: They had carefully kept the drama props in a box.

definition: to become reduced in size or bulk; to draw together; to shrink or contract oneself.
example_en: The leaves shrank and curled up due to the cold.

definition: the outer rim of a wheel; felly.
example_en: The old wheel's felly had worn out.

definition: the short, deep, hoarse and reverberating, roar of a bull; bellow; grunt.
example_en: In the distance the bellow of a bull was heard.

definition: any bacterial toxin mixed with one's food with the intention of causing sickness; food-poison.
example_en: The enemies had mixed food-poison into the food.

definition: a condemning or being condemned; the act of denouncing or accusing; condemnation.
example: ಸಭೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನ ವರ್ತನೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತೀವ್ರ ಪ್ರತಿಘ ವ್ಯಕ್ತವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Severe condemnation of his conduct was expressed in the assembly.

definition: a plant disease (esp. of Indian millet) caused by certain mites.
example: ಕುಂಕುಮರೋಗ ಬಾಧಿಸಿದ ಕಾರಣ ಜೋಳದ ಬೆಳೆ ಹಾಳಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The crop of Indian millet was ruined because the mite disease affected it.

definition: a man who is authorised to perform certain duties or tasks; a commissioner.
example_en: The commissioner (samadhikrta) has taken responsibility for this project.

definition: specially; especially; with an importance particularly to.
example_en: One must pay attention especially to this matter.

definition: (pl.) people whose mother tongue is Tuḷu.
example: ಆರ್ಗಳ್ ತಮ್ಮ ಭಾಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತನಾಡುತ್ತಾ ಸಂತೋಷದಿಂದ ಇದ್ದರು.
example_en: The Tulu-speaking people were happily talking in their own language.

definition: being present in a physical form.
example_en: The teacher appeared physically present before the disciples.

definition: a place where tiffin, meals, beverages, etc. can be bought and eaten; a restaurant.
example_en: That restaurant is famous for its coffee.

definition: the plant Phaseolus trilobus of Papilionaceae family.
example_en: The vanamudga vine was found at the edge of the forest.

definition: a prolonged, open fight between two opposing military forces; a war.
example_en: A war broke out between the two kingdoms.

definition: the sound made by high-speed wind.
example_en: The sound of the high-speed wind struck my ears.

definition: the state or fact of being not bound (physically, morally or socially); the state of being ungoverned by any rule or principle.
example_en: Because of his unruliness, the work was abandoned.

definition: to become more corpulent, fatty.
example_en: Due to laziness he became even more corpulent.

definition: the end of a needle which has a hole for thread.
example_en: It was difficult to thread the yarn through the eye of the needle.

definition: bent; bowed.
example_en: The old man's back was bent due to age.

definition: the act or fact of eating food.
example_en: Everyone rested after eating.

definition: to greatly rejoice; to be delighted.
example_en: Hearing the wedding news, she greatly rejoiced.

definition: a kind of frog .
example: ಮಳೆಯ ನಂತರ ಜಾಳಗಪ್ಪೆಯೊಂದು ಕಲ್ಲಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: After the rain, a kind of frog was sitting on the stone.

definition: a taking of a dead body to a cemetery or crematory.
example_en: The people followed silently in the procession taking the dead body to the crematory.

definition: a strong alcoholic liquor produced by distillation; spirit.
example_en: That spirit is used as medicine.

definition: immediately; quickly.
example_en: On hearing the news he left quickly.

definition: a hillock or small hill.
example: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಹತ್ತಿರ ಒಂದು ಸಣ್ಣ ಪಹಡು ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is a small hillock near the village.

definition: to sit - a) to rest the weight of the body upon the buttocks and the back of the thighs, as on a chair, the floor, a mat, etc.; to be seated; b) (a quadruped) to rest on the haunches with the forelegs braced; c) (a bird) to perch or roost.
example_en: The child tried to sit on the chair.

definition: to consume or apply a medicine.
example_en: When he got fever, he had to take medicine.

definition: to act kindly or charitably; to be benevolent.
example: ಬಡವರಿಗೆ ದರ್ಮಗೆಯ್ದು ಅವನು ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಹೆಸರು ಗಳಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: By acting charitably towards the poor, he earned a good name.

definition: the roof of a building.
example_en: The roof of the old temple was dilapidated.

definition: anything worn to adorn, decorate the body; an ornament.
example_en: The bride was wearing gold ornaments.

definition: to be in an order.
example_en: All the soldiers stood being in order.

definition: a restive, unruly horse
example_en: The unruly horse kept bucking and ran off.

definition: a curved or bent piece of metal, wood, etc.; a hook; a bend.
example_en: That iron hook was fitted onto the door.

definition: in animals and plants, a part composed of specialised tissues and adapted to the performance of a specific function or functions; an organ.
example: ಹೃದಯ ಮಾನವ ದೇಹದ ಒಂದು ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅವಯವ.
example_en: The heart is an important organ of the human body.

definition: a crossing of a river; ferrying.
example_en: Crossing the river by boat was very difficult.

definition: the end part of the leg, on which a person or animal stands or moves; a foot.
example_en: His foot got wounded when a thorn pricked it.

definition: the red Indian crane.
example_en: The red Indian crane stood on the pond's bank.

definition: to be afraid of; to fear; to feel fright; to be terrified.
example_en: The child saw the darkness and became frightened.

definition: a minor folk goddess.
example_en: The people of that village worship the folk goddess Gaḍigemma.

definition: a written letter or communication that is forged, counterfeit or false.
example_en: That forged document was rejected in the court.

definition: a hook attached to or driven into a wall, wooden pillar, beam, etc. for hanging light objects.
example_en: They hung the lamp on the hook fixed to the pillar.

definition: a bad smell.
example_en: A bad smell was coming from that dirty area.

definition: the joint that connects the foot and the leg; the ankle.
example_en: He stumbled on a stone and his ankle hurt.

definition: (fig.) a being spoiled or destroyed completely.
example_en: All his property was completely destroyed in the flood.

definition: the Supreme Being.
example_en: The Supreme Soul resides in all living beings.

definition: a small stone.
example: ಮಗು ಪಿಡಿಕಲ್ ಅನ್ನು ಎತ್ತಿ ನೀರಿಗೆ ಎಸೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The child picked up a small stone and threw it into the water.

definition: (dial.) if it is so; in case it is so.
example: ಅಂಬಗ ನೀನೂ ಬಾ ಎಂದು ಅವನು ಹೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: He said, if it is so, you too come.

definition: without a doubt; undoubtedly; certainly.
example_en: That he will win is a fact without a doubt.

definition: a beautiful woman.
example: ಆ ಕಥೆಯ ವರವರ್ಣಿನಿ ಇಡೀ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧಳಾಗಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: The beautiful woman in that story was famous throughout the town.

definition: to become muddy; to be full of or spattered with mud.
example_en: The children's clothes became spattered with mud while playing.

definition: a female singer.
example_en: That female singer sang melodiously at the gathering.

definition: to act or wait eagerly with a feeling of anxiety or impatience; to rare to do, go or have.
example_en: The children waited eagerly and anxiously for the exam results.

definition: a small soft-furred four-legged domesticated animal, Felis catus; a cat.
example_en: The cat plays with the child.

definition: a verbal testimony, proof or oral evidence.
example_en: The witness's verbal testimony was recorded in the court.

definition: a bunch of flowers.
example_en: The poet described the bunch of flowers in the poem.

definition: Subrahmaṇya, the son Śiva.
example_en: The devotees bowed to Subrahmanya.

definition: the quality, state or fact of being certain; certainty.
example_en: There was no certainty in his words.

definition: all the words of a language; vocabulary.
example_en: The vocabulary of Kannada is abundant in this dictionary.

definition: a heavy trampling with the foot.
example_en: The ground shook from the heavy trampling of the elephants' feet.

definition: (mus.) a mode, in old system, now obsolete.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಗ್ರಂಥದಲ್ಲಿ ಛಾಯಾತೋಡಿ ಎಂಬ ರಾಗದ ಉಲ್ಲೇಖವಿದೆ.
example_en: The old treatise mentions a musical mode called chāyā tōḍi.

definition: not hard; soft.
example_en: The child's hair was soft.

definition: the split seed of any of the leguminous plants as pea.
example_en: Mother cooked the split lentils.

definition: to dip, immerse or soak in boiling water.
example_en: She soaked the cloth in boiling water.

definition: a place of dwelling; a house.
example: ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ಎಕ್ಕೆಯನ್ನು ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಪಟ್ಟಣಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋದನು.
example_en: He left his dwelling and went to the town.

definition: a large organised body of soldiers for waging war (on land, in air and on sea).
example: ರಾಜನ ಸೇನೆ ಶತ್ರುಗಳ ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಯುದ್ಧಕ್ಕೆ ಹೊರಟಿತು.
example_en: The king's army marched out to war against the enemies.

definition: to attack in a forceful, violent, hostile or aggressive way.
example_en: The soldiers launched a forceful attack on the fort.

definition: a kind of fig tree.
example_en: The fig tree had grown on the river bank.
